328f33c.summary: Resolves a unit-disappear action: hides the target's GameObject (warns if none), then does the shared end-of-action work. That work reassembles minions, ends the battle if a hero is dead, clears the resolving flag and refreshes whose turn it is (hero/minion activation, hand highlighting).
comments: Hide the disappearing unit's object; a missing target only logs a warning
If no actions remain and this wasn't a reorder, queue a reassemble order for any minions out of position

cardState 5 (waitingToDie) on either hero means the match is over
Build and log a debug string describing the hero death state
Already in PostBattle and not a disconnect loss: nothing more to do
Disconnect-loss flag set: record an Enemy win and run the battle end sequence as a coroutine
Normal end: enter PostBattle, stop the battle, and tell the opponent the match finished if networked
Player won: raise an EnemyHealthChangeSignal carrying the enemy hero's health
Get Elo rating and winner, then create the ranked match result with the current XP
Store skull counts (milestones) in the result; enemy count depends on the player hero's health
Record the match duration and winner; a player win sets matchEndedWithAWin
Certain match types (0x14, 0xd2, 0xb4) also tell LiveOps the player is human
Save the result and call BattleFinished; the battle ends here

If the player has only the end-turn action left, show the no-actions UI hint

3290a80.summary: Resolves a transform action: swaps the target card's data for a new card (in play or in hand), re-runs setup, optionally adds an effect, refreshes hands, and updates warlord chat for heroes. Then runs the shared end-of-action work (battle-end check, turn refresh).
comments: Target card present: transform it
Remember whether it was in play before the change
If it was the selected active-ability card, stop displaying that ability
In play: mark it as transforming so removal does not count as death
Tell listeners it left the game, and strip hand effects tied to it
Flag set: remove only own extrinsic effects; otherwise reset to hand values and cancel effects from the old unit
Load the new card data and run card setup for its owner's army
Put it back as an in-play unit (with entry animation) or as a unit in hand
If the action carries an effect, add it to the transformed card
Flag set: refresh figures and replaced ability
In play: update continuous effects, stun, figures, and re-apply ambush if it has the trait
Refresh card effects in both hands and re-check effects on the new card if it is in hand
Finish resolving the action
Transformed hero: update warlord chat lines and show its intro message
Null target path: log an error, then fall into the shared end-of-action code (decompiler merged FinishResolvingAction)
